title: Is the 10x Engineer a Myth?
summary: Short vlog asserting the 10x engineer is real, that some engineers are 100x or more, and that hard work can get anyone there.

assertions.quote: I think it's very very like very possible to be 10 times better than the average engineer
if you just put in the hard work you can be 10 times better like 10x better than the average engineer

verdicts.note: Weekly output of munitions workers reached a maximum near 63 h and the marginal product of further hours was negative, so a ceiling on what extra hours can buy exists at least for physical piece work; programming was not studied.

assertions.quote: these projects are so complicated that the average engineer couldn't even solve that project
